clips.title: The story
paras: Bitter Rivals is an early Alliance quest in Dun Morogh born from the fierce competition between two proud dwarven brewing families. Marleth Barleybrew sends an adventurer to infiltrate the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos and tamper with their rival's stock.

Few things in Khaz Modan stir passions as quickly as a pint of ale. The Barleybrews have long bristled under the shadow of the famed Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. While Marleth Barleybrew begrudgingly concedes that Thunderbrew craft is respectable, she cannot stomach the notion that it is the only renowned vintage in Dun Morogh. To shake up the local palate, she devises a plan to swap a cask of Thunder Ale with her own fiery concoction, Barleybrew Scalder.

Carrying out the scheme requires slipping directly beneath the noses of Kharanos patrons. Beneath the kitchen of the distillery lies the basement storeroom where aging casks await tapping. Because the Thunderbrews keep a guard posted near their most prized reserve, a would-be saboteur must find a way to lure the watchman away before secretly substituting the barrels.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have to admit, those Thunderbrews make some good drinks. But they need to learn that theirs isn't the only decent brew! Maybe you can help me teach them that lesson...

Here, take this barrel of Barleybrew Scalder. Sneak into the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos and switch it with one of their barrels of Thunder Ale. Then we'll see how their patrons like my brew over theirs!
And if the barrels are guarded, then you might have to distract the guard...

clips.title: Progress
paras: The date on this barrel shows that it'll soon be tapped.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You quickly place Marleth's barrel of Barleybrew Scalder among the Thunderbrew barrels.
